title: Contraindications pour Intravenous Thrombolysis (IVT) pour Ischemic AVC
formula:
**2026 Absolute Contraindications**

| Absolute Contraindications |
| --- |
| CT with extensive hypodensity |
| CT with acute intracranial hemorrhage |
| Moderate to severe traumatic brain injury within 14 days |
| Neurosurgery within 14 days |
| Acute spinal cord injury within 3 months |
| Intra-axial neoplasm |
| Infective endocarditis |
| Severe Coagulopathy |
| Severe thrombocytopenia |
| Aortic arch dissection |
| Amyloid-related imaging abnormalities (ARIA) |

**2026 Relative Contraindications**

| Relative Contraindication |
| --- |
| Pre-existing disability and/or frailty |
| DOAC exposure within 48 hours |
| Ischemic stroke within 3 months |
| Prior intracranial hemorrhage (ICH) |
| Major Non- CNS trauma in last 14 days-3 months |
| Major non-CNS surgery within 10 days |
| GI / GU bleeding within last 21 days |
| Intracranial arterial dissection |
| Intracranial vascular malformations |
| STEMI within last 3 months |
| STEMI within past several days |
| STEMI concurrent with AIS |
| Acute pericarditis |
| Left atrial or ventricular thrombus |
| Systemic active malignancy |
| Pregnancy and postpartum period |
| Dural procedure within last 7 days |
| Arterial puncture within last 7 days |
| Moderate to severe traumatic brain injury in last 14 days to 3 months |
| Neurosurgery in last 14 days to 3 months |

how_to_use.why: Le principal risque de l’IVT est l’hémorragie symptomatique ou fatale. Il est essentiel que les patients soient évalués quant à tout antécédent ou facteur de risque qui les exposerait à un risque accru d’issue hémorragique.
how_to_use.when: La liste des contre-indications absolues et relatives à l’IVT doit être passée en revue chez tout patient présentant un AVC ischémique aigu chez qui une thrombolyse est envisagée.
how_to_use.pearls:
- There are strict protocols concerning the appropriate administration of IVT in patients with ischemic stroke.
- IVT is considered for individuals with acute ischemic stroke with disabling symptoms (i.e. interference with ability to complete basic activities of daily living) regardless of NIHSS score.
- For patients within the 4.5-hour treatment window who meet the inclusion criteria and have no contraindications, administration of IV tenecteplase or alteplase should be initiated as quickly as possible.
- IVT for patients with acute ischemic stroke is associated with a significant increase in symptomatic intracranial hemorrhage, so it is essential to adhere to accepted protocols and to engage in shared decision making with the patient or their family.

next_steps.critical_actions:
- Patients presenting with a potential acute ischemic stroke should have a non-contrast CT scan of the head performed as soon as is safely possible.
- If the patient is a candidate for thrombolysis with IVT they should be carefully evaluated for any absolute or relative contraindications.
- The [NIHSS](nabda:calc.nih-stroke-scale-score-nihss) should be performed as part of their evaluation, by a [NIHSS](nabda:calc.nih-stroke-scale-score-nihss) certified provider if one is available.
- If the patient has an elevated blood pressure (SBP >185 or DBP >110) as their only contraindication to receiving IVT, consider using parenteral medication to lower their blood pressure to an acceptable level. If the blood pressure can be adequately controlled, the patient may be safely given IVT if they meet the inclusion criteria and have no other contraindications.
next_steps.management:
In patients who present with symptoms concerning for ischemic stroke:

- Consult neurology.
- Determine the onset of stroke symptoms (or time patient last felt or was observed normal).
- Obtain a stat head CT to evaluate for hemorrhagic stroke.
- In appropriate circumstances and in consultation with both neurology and the patient, consider IV thrombolysis for ischemic strokes in patients with no contraindications.
- Suggested dosing for [tenecteplase](nabda:calc.tenecteplase-dosing) is 0.25mg/kg (max dose 25mg).
- Suggested dosing for [alteplase](nabda:calc.tpa-tissue-plasminogen-activator-dosing-stroke-calculator) is 0.9mg/kg.

IV thrombolysis can also be considered in some individuals who have symptoms of acute ischemic stroke and imaging evidence of salvageable ischemic penumbra by automated perfusion imagingor MRI-based diffusion weighted imaging and FLAIR mismatchin extended or uncertain time windows:

- Awakening with stroke symptoms within 9 hours from the midpoint of sleep or are 4.5-9 hours from last known well.
- 4.5-24 hours from symptom onset due to large vessel occlusion (LVO) but unable to receive endovascular thrombectomy and who are under direction of thrombolytic stroke care experts.
- Unknown symptom onset but within 4.5 hours of symptom recognition.

evidence:
- La majorité des critères d'exclusion sont fondés sur les patients exclus des essais originaux NINDS I et II ([Adams 1996](https://circ.ahajournals.org/content/94/5/1167.full)).
- Les recommandations actuelles suggèrent que le tPA peut être envisagé chez les patients présentant 1 ou plusieurs contre-indications relatives, mais uniquement après une analyse réfléchie du rapport risque/bénéfice et en concertation avec le patient et/ou sa famille chaque fois que possible ([Jauch 2013](https://stroke.ahajournals.org/content/44/3/870.full)).
more_info: Pour la liste complète des critères d’inclusion/d’exclusion et des recommandations sur l’AVC ischémique, consultez les[Recommandations ASA 2026 pour la prise en charge précoce des patients présentant un AVC ischémique](https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/epub/10.1161/STR.0000000000000513).
short_description: Critères d’inclusion et d’exclusion pour l’IVT.
medium_description: Provides inclusion/exclusion critères pour IVT dans aigu ischemic AVC patients.

input_schema.name: diagnosis
input_schema.label: Diagnostic clinique d’un AVC ischémique responsable d’un déficit neurologique.

input_schema.name: symptom_onset
input_schema.label: Délai depuis le début des symptômes < 4.5 heures

input_schema.name: a
input_schema.label: TDM avec hypodensité étendue
input_schema.tips: “Clear hypodensity” means the degree of hypodensity is greater than the density of contralateral unaffected white matter. Extensive changes account for the regions explaining symptoms.

input_schema.name: c
input_schema.label: Modéré pour severe traumatic brain lésion within 14 days
input_schema.tips: Defined as >30 minutes of unconsciousness and GCS <13 OR evidence of hemorrhage, contusion, or skull fracture on neuroimaging.

input_schema.name: d
input_schema.label: Neurochirurgie dans les 14 jours
input_schema.tips: Défini comme une chirurgie intracrânienne ou rachidienne.

input_schema.name: e
input_schema.label: Lésion médullaire aiguë dans les 3 mois

input_schema.name: h
input_schema.label: Coagulopathie sévère
input_schema.tips: INR>1.7, aPTT>40s, or PT>15s; IVT may be initiated before these lab results are obtained if no clinical suspicion for coagulopathy.

input_schema.name: i
input_schema.label: Thrombopénie sévère
input_schema.tips: Platelets <100,000/mm³.

input_schema.name: k
input_schema.label: Anomalies d'imagerie liées à l'amyloïde (ARIA)
input_schema.tips: Associé à l'immunothérapie anti-amyloïde.

input_schema.name: l
input_schema.label: Handicap préexistant et/ou fragilité
input_schema.tips: Le traitement doit être déterminé au cas par cas.

input_schema.name: m
input_schema.label: Exposition aux DOAC dans les 48 heures
input_schema.tips: Treatment should be determined based on last dose, renal function, stroke severity, and availability of EVT/DOAC reversal agents.

input_schema.name: p
input_schema.label: Traumatisme majeur non-CNS au cours des 14 jours à 3 mois précédents
input_schema.tips: Une consultation auprès d’experts en chirurgie est appropriée.

input_schema.name: q
input_schema.label: Chirurgie majeure non-CNS dans les 10 jours
input_schema.tips: Une consultation auprès d’experts en chirurgie est appropriée.

input_schema.name: r
input_schema.label: Saignement digestif/génito-urinaire au cours des 21 derniers jours
input_schema.tips: Une consultation auprès d’experts en chirurgie est appropriée.

input_schema.name: u
input_schema.label: STEMI dans les 3 derniers mois
input_schema.tips: Individual risk/benefit discussion and emergent cardiology consultation.

input_schema.name: v
input_schema.label: STEMI au cours des derniers jours
input_schema.tips: Risk of hemopericardium should be considered and emergent cardiology consultation.

input_schema.name: w
input_schema.label: STEMI concomitant avec AIS
input_schema.tips: Envisager un traitement à une posologie adaptée à l’ischémie cérébrale et en association avec une consultation cardiologique urgente.

input_schema.name: x
input_schema.label: Péricardite aiguë
input_schema.tips: Consultation spécialisée recommandée.

input_schema.name: y
input_schema.label: Thrombus auriculaire gauche ou ventriculaire
input_schema.tips: Consultation spécialisée recommandée.

input_schema.name: z
input_schema.label: Néoplasie active systémique
input_schema.tips: Consultation spécialisée recommandée.

input_schema.name: aa
input_schema.label: Grossesse et période postpartum
input_schema.tips: Consultation spécialisée recommandée.

input_schema.name: ab
input_schema.label: Procédure durale au cours des 7 derniers jours
input_schema.tips: Consultation spécialisée recommandée.

input_schema.name: ac
input_schema.label: Ponction artérielle au cours des 7 derniers jours
input_schema.tips: Specialty consultation recommended particularly for non-compressible site.

input_schema.name: ad
input_schema.label: Modéré pour severe traumatic brain lésion dans last 14 days pour 3 months
input_schema.tips: Consultation spécialisée recommandée.

input_schema.name: ae
input_schema.label: Neurosurgery dans last 14 days pour 3 months
input_schema.tips: Consultation spécialisée recommandée.

instructions:
Institutions may have slightly different absolute and relative contraindications to IV thrombolysis (IVT); this list is meant to be a quick reference, but practice should be guided by institutional protocol and consultation with neurology. Reflects recommendations from[Prabhakaran 2026](https://www.ahajournals.org/doi/10.1161/STR.0000000000000211).

For alteplase dosing, see [Alteplase Dosing for Ischemic Stroke](nabda:calc.tpa-tissue-plasminogen-activator-dosing-stroke-calculator) .

For tenecteplase dosing, see [TNK Dosing for Ischemic Stroke](nabda:calc.tenecteplase-dosing) .
